newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-EP BATTING FIRST AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-EP BATTING FIRST AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Eastern Province captain, Kepler Wessels, won the toss and elected to bat first on the opening day of their Supersport series cricket match against Natal at St George's Park on Friday.
Eastern Province - Gavin Victor, Louis Koen, Kepler Wessels (captain), Dave Callaghan, Mark Rushmere, Grant Morgan, Eldine Baptiste, Tim Shaw, Geoff Love, Mornantau Hayward, Wikus Botha.
Natal - Mark Bruyns, Errol Stewart, Derek Crookes, Jonty Rhodes, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Neil Johnson, Keith Forde, Pat Symcox, Doug Watson, Gary Gilder, Tertius Bosch.
